title: Human Resources Compliance Manager
description:
**WE ARE HIRING | HUMAN RESOURCE & COMPLIANCE MANAGER**

**Bhuvaneswari Tex | Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

Bhuvaneswari Tex is looking for an experienced
**HR & Compliance Manager**
in garment manufacturing to oversee HR operations, statutory compliance, employee welfare, and labour-related requirements across our garment manufacturing facility.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Manage HR operations, employee records, attendance, and payroll coordination.

• Ensure compliance with
**labour laws, statutory regulations, and factory requirements**
.

• Handle audits, inspections, and compliance documentation.

• Manage employee welfare, grievance handling, and disciplinary procedures.

**Requirements:**

• 5+ years of relevant experience in
**HR & Compliance within garment manufacturing**
.

• Strong knowledge of
**labour laws, statutory compliance, factory compliance, and HR practices**
.

• Experience handling
**social compliance audits**
and buyer compliance requirements will be preferred.

• Strong communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

📍
**Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Interested candidates can share their CV with us at**
info@b-tex.com
